_comment: riverfarm_fight's start. warrior5+mage5 (the harness-tuned 'warrior5_mage5' build, matching door_chain_fight_start's shape). `hunter_will_come` is NOT pre-banked here -- the script earns it LIVE (the come-along beat at the village hunter, before TRAVEL) so all three live fights field riverfarm_hunter as an ally (briar_collectors/briar_collectors_deep/river_wolf_pack all ship allies:[riverfarm_hunter]/ally_requires:{hunter_will_come:1}, matching sim_combat_batch.gd's own gated/measured _hunter cells rather than the much harder _solo siblings; NOT Relc -- Riverfarm is a solo Door arrival with no fictional basis for the Liscor Watch, see combatants.json's riverfarm_hunter _comment). met_relc/sparred_with_relc/given_spear_by_relc stay banked as genuine unrelated tutorial-arc history (harmless, no longer read by any Riverfarm gate). CONSTRAINT: riverfarm_attuned implies the portal network is already awake (data/portals.json's own requires_accomplishment contract -- there is no door to Riverfarm from the inn's pantry_door until it wakes), so the full awakening chain (door_chain_started/door_understood/recovered_anchor_stone/bought_catalyst/door_study_sleeps/door_awakened) is banked alongside it; door_understood's provenance is the TALK/SKILL leg convention shared with near_riverfarm/the door-chain family, so rift_vermin_leak/ruin_guardian correctly stay unfought/live, and none of these ids gate anything riverfarm_fight itself reads. Standing at (11,10) facing up, directly south of riverfarm_headman (11,9) -- first interact plays his talk_pool line, second opens riverfarm_headman. heard_price_of_a_favor is NOT banked and the quest is NOT started -- the script proves the full give -> ask the hunter along -> travel -> clear both waves -> report -> completion loop honestly. TRAP: rng_state is a properly-derived state (.seed=1, captured .state = -1966449618399012673), never hand-typed -- WISave restores .state directly, not .seed, so a hand-typed small int collapses the first randi() draw to the same degenerate output regardless of which small int is picked. All three live fights (briar_collectors/briar_collectors_deep/river_wolf_pack) land victories with riverfarm_hunter allied off this state. If a future roster/data change ever flips one of the three, re-search by seeding candidate N=1,2,3... through the derive-then-verify loop (tests/_derive_rng_state.gd prints the .state per seed; patch this field, re-run riverfarm_fight) until all three land victories at one shared starting state.
